BiblicalUsage: Noph means elevation, height, a raised place. Psalm 48:2 calls Mount Zion beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, and the word is the lift of the city itself: Jerusalem set high on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God lifts His city where the whole earth can see it, because the place He chooses is never hidden.
